tips.text: Taegeuk refers to the source of everything in the universe
and the universal law in which everything continuously goes through cycles of creation and destruction.
Taegeuk Yukjang stands for Gang and symbolizes the endless flow of water and its flexibility.
Taegeuk Yukjang is the final stage of the intermediate course
and is characterized by a smooth and flexible connection
when performing moves in succession or changing direction.
